  1. Work

KiberQalqon — a cybersecurity dashboard prototype

A dashboard concept for a security operations centre (SOC): alerts, a threat map and response actions on one screen.

Client
Our concept
Industry
Cybersecurity
Status
Interactive prototype
Year
2026

Challenge

Potential buyers and investors needed to see in advance how a platform combining SIEM, XDR and SOAR layers would look and work.

Solution

Incidents on a map of Uzbekistan and a detail panel for every alert: IP owner and geolocation, MITRE ATT&CK classification, kill chain stage and technical logs.

A glossary explaining 20 cybersecurity terms in Uzbek, with dark and light modes.

Result

The prototype was built to show the product idea in presentations. All of its data is sample data and it is not connected to real systems.

Showing the idea before building it.

  • Threat map

    A GeoJSON map of Uzbekistan with incidents.

  • Alert details

    Reputation risk, MITRE ATT&CK and the response taken.

  • Glossary

    Every term explained in Uzbek, with search.

  • Two modes

    Dark and light themes.

Technology

React 18ViteGeoJSON
